interval_take: D9 (Friday Mar 27) delivered ~₹40 Cr India nett per night estimates — occupancy held at 40–41% overall with 60% night shows (addatoday). This is a marginal drop from D8 ₹49.70 Cr but still exceptional for a second Friday. D0–D9 BOI canonical total: ~₹709 Cr. Sacnilk's higher D5 figure (₹65 Cr vs BOI ₹60 Cr) means their cumulative is ~₹14 Cr higher — not adopted by Boxoffy. Project Hail Mary India story is IMAX: the film was initially given just 5 IMAX screens (13 shows) across 34 IMAX theatres in India — all occupied by D2. Fan backlash prompted expansion to 60 IMAX screens by D2. PHM is tracking ₹9–11 Cr extended OW (Pinkvilla). US: PHM dominating Wkd 2 at ~$46.8M (-42%), comparable to Dune: Part Two's 2nd weekend. D2 NA running $23M — has beaten Baahubali 2's $22M NA lifetime.

interval_take: Boxoffy correction issued. After cross-referencing BOI and Pinkvilla against Sacnilk, Sacnilk Hindi figures appear inflated — particularly D1 where Sacnilk reports ₹99.1 Cr vs BOI ₹75 Cr and Pinkvilla ₹73 Cr, a 33% gap. Pinkvilla and BOI align closely throughout. Revised canonical: BOI Hindi D0-D7 ₹532 Cr + other languages ~₹30 Cr = ~₹562 Cr India nett. WW ₹1,006.50 Cr is not disputed — Sacnilk WW uses confirmed distributor data. BLOCKBUSTER verdict and all records unchanged — D2 is still historic at any number.
